detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Note: Requires the base game Serpent's Gaze to access this content.

Enjoying Serpent's Gaze and want to support its future? — And look rather dashing while doing it? This supporter pack is a great way to help us keep developing and further improve this game for you!

This pack includes 4 new skins for the Magnolia warrior

  • Black

  • Purple

  • Orange

  • Turquoise

After purchasing the pack you will be able to activate the new colors in the game settings under Gameplay > Cosmetic. When enabled, you will don the black while any other player will get their color assigned from the remaining three. These colors will only be visible to you when enabled.

Thank you for supporting Serpent's Gaze!

Important note: Buying this pack is intended for those who wish to show your support for the game and the developer. It does not add or alter any gameplay.
